metadata.dataset_title: Bangladeshi Dishes Knowledge Base — Dish Ingredient Estimates and Lab Findings
metadata.portion_policy: Every grams_raw quantity is labelled ESTIMATE. serving_weight_g is also ESTIMATE. Neither ingredient quantities nor serving weights are represented as source-measured.
metadata.nutrition_policy: No dish totals are calculated. The sole matched lab-analyzed dish is Chicken Roast from INFS (2026), recorded per 100 g cooked exactly as published rather than scaled to a serving.
permitted_sources_only: USDA FoodData Central (not used in this version)
INFS, University of Dhaka studies of cooked Bangladeshi dishes on BanglaJOL
metadata.dish_recipe_policy: Ingredient selection, method labels and per-serving quantities are structured estimates to support the intended schema. The allowed source set was not used to claim source-verified recipes for all 30 dishes.
metadata.expert_review: needs_expert_review is true for every dish. Do not publish as authoritative nutrition or recipe advice until the source base, quantities, allergens and cooking methods have been reviewed.
metadata.batching: Six ordered batches of five dishes each; each dish has batch_number 1–6.

dishes_with_verified_matching_lab_data.note: No dish totals calculated; energy remains null where not directly reported.

source_audit.important_limit: For 29 dishes, no exact matching lab-analyzed nutrient profile was verified from the permitted INFS/BanglaJOL sources during this pass. These remain nutrition_basis=unavailable. Ingredient lists, recipe methods, ingredient grams and cooked serving weights are estimates, not source-verified standardized recipes.

lab_values_per_serving.source_table: Table 5, after-cook row; the reported values are composition fields (moisture, protein, fat, available carbohydrate, total dietary fibre, ash). The initial 260 is cooked sample weight in grams, not energy.
lab_values_per_serving.note: Study-reported cooked composition is retained on its published per-100-g basis; the leading 260 in the table is cooked sample weight in grams, not energy. energy_kcal is null because no directly reported energy value was verified. Values are not scaled to this dataset's estimated serving and are not calculated from ingredients. The study's standardized recipe may differ from this dataset's estimated ingredient list. No sodium, saturated-fat or sugar value is claimed where it was not reported.
